extra_vocab.en: the smallest amount that is allowed or needed
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，minimum charge 是私人包廂的「最低消費」，也就是人數增加後，至少要消費 600 美元。餐廳通知時常用這個說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: minimum 當形容詞放在名詞前（minimum charge）；當名詞時常用 a minimum of + 數字 或 at a minimum。

example.en: The minimum charge for the banquet hall is $1,000.
example.zh: 宴會廳的最低消費是一千美元。

example.en: The supplier has a minimum order of fifty units.
example.zh: 這家供應商的最低訂購量是五十件。

example.en: The minimum wage will increase at the start of next year.
example.zh: 基本工資會在明年初調漲。

example.en: At a minimum, you should confirm the booking by phone.
example.zh: 你至少應該用電話確認訂位。

examples.en: A minimum of ten guests is required for the private room.
examples.zh: 包廂至少需要十位賓客。

examples.en: Please keep costs to a minimum while we review the budget.
examples.zh: 在我們檢討預算期間，請把成本壓到最低。

confusable.diff: minimal 是「極少的、微小的」，描述程度很小；minimum 是「最低的」，指一個規定的下限。

example.en: The delay caused only minimal disruption to our schedule.
example.zh: 這次延誤對我們的時程只造成極小的影響。

similar.diff: at least 是副詞片語，口語自然；minimum 是形容詞或名詞，多用於規定與合約。

example.en: You must order at least ten sets to get the discount.
example.zh: 你至少要訂十組才能享有折扣。

example.en: The maximum capacity of the room is forty people.
example.zh: 這間房間的最大容量是四十人。

example.en: There is a limit of two guests per member.
example.zh: 每位會員限帶兩位賓客。

example.en: A small service fee applies to all bookings.
example.zh: 所有預訂都要收一筆小額服務費。

derived.link: minim- 表示「最小」，加 -al 變形容詞，像 additional
minim- + -ize，把事情「變到最小」，像 organize、realize

example.en: There is a minimum age requirement for this program.
example.zh: 這個計畫有最低年齡限制。

example.en: We try to keep waste to a minimum.
example.zh: 我們盡量把浪費減到最低。

extra_vocab.en: the things that someone has chosen, or the act of choosing
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，final menu selections 是賓客「最後選定的餐點」。餐廳需要在期限前拿到名單，才能為過敏賓客做準備。

example.en: Please send your menu selection by email this week.
example.zh: 請在本週用電子郵件寄來你選定的餐點。

example.en: The caterer offers a wide selection of vegetarian dishes.
example.zh: 這家外燴業者提供種類豐富的素食餐點。

example.en: Guests must make a selection before the deadline.
example.zh: 賓客必須在截止日前做出選擇。

example.en: The final selection will be announced on Friday.
example.zh: 最終的選擇會在星期五公布。

examples.en: The restaurant has an excellent selection of local wines.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳有很棒的在地葡萄酒選擇。

examples.en: The selection of the new manager will take two weeks.
examples.zh: 挑選新經理需要兩週時間。

confusable.diff: election 是「選舉」，用於投票選出人；selection 是一般的「挑選」。

example.en: The election of the new board chair is next month.
example.zh: 新任董事長的選舉在下個月。

similar.diff: choice 指「選擇的行為或選項」，較口語；selection 常指「挑出來的一組項目」。

example.en: Your choice of entrée must be confirmed in advance.
example.zh: 你選的主餐必須事先確認。

similar.diff: option 強調「可以選的方案」；selection 強調「選出來的結果」或「可選的種類」。

example.en: We have three payment options for you.
example.zh: 我們提供你三種付款選項。

example.en: You have a choice between fish and chicken.
example.zh: 你可以在魚和雞肉之間選擇。

example.en: Which option do you prefer for the venue?
example.zh: 場地你比較喜歡哪個選項？

derived.link: 詞幹 select（挑選）；加 -ion 變名詞 selection，像 collect → collection

senses.en: the things that someone has chosen

example.en: Please confirm your selection before the end of the day.
example.zh: 請在今天結束前確認你的選擇。

senses.en: a group of things that you can choose from
senses.distinguish: 常和 wide、large、good 連用（a wide selection），指商店或菜單的品項多寡。

example.en: The store carries a large selection of office furniture.
example.zh: 這家店販售種類眾多的辦公家具。

extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，餐廳要求最遲在星期三中午前拿到最終餐點選擇，才能為兩位堅果過敏的賓客做準備。語氣正式，是明確的截止時間。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: no later than 後面接時間點，並且包含該時間點本身（no later than noon 就是中午前都算）；數量上的「不超過」要用 no more than。

examples.en: Please send your reply no later than Friday at noon.
examples.zh: 請最遲在星期五中午前回覆。

examples.en: Guests must check out no later than eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 房客最遲必須在十一點前退房。

examples.en: We need the revised quotation no later than the end of the week.
examples.zh: 我們最遲需要在本週末前拿到修正後的報價。

similar.diff: by 比較簡短口語；no later than 語氣更正式，強調「不可晚於」。

example.en: Please submit the form by Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 請在星期二早上前交出表格。

similar.diff: at the latest 放在時間後面，語氣口語，意思是「最晚」。

example.en: I need your answer by Monday at the latest.
example.zh: 我最晚星期一要拿到你的答覆。

confusable.diff: no more than 用在數量，表示「不超過」；no later than 用在時間，表示「不晚於」。

example.en: Each guest may bring no more than one companion.
example.zh: 每位賓客最多只能帶一位同伴。
